summary:
Strategic HR Leader with 15+ years of experience driving people strategy for leading retail and fashion organizations across digital, e-commerce,
and brick-and-mortar formats. Expert in HR Business Partnering, talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, and large-scale transformation
initiatives. Demonstrated success in partnering with executive leadership to design scalable structures, optimize workforce costs, and enhance
employee engagement in fast-growing environments.
Known for building future-ready organizations through data-led insights, leadership development, succession planning, and culture stewardship.
Adept at navigating complexity, influencing stakeholders, and delivering high-impact HR solutions that accelerate business growth while
strengthening employee experience and retention.

bullets: Partner With Digital And Brand Leadership To Translate Business Priorities Into HR Strategies Across Manpower Planning, Talent Deployment, And Capability Building For Digital, Women’s Wear, And Arrow Businesses.
Lead end-to-end HRBP responsibilities including org design, manpower budgeting, performance management, succession planning, and employee life cycle interventions for corporate and retail roles.
Drive performance culture by anchoring goal setting, KRAs/KPIs, mid-year and annual reviews, and capability discussions; ensure timely completion and quality of PMS outcomes.
Strengthen talent pipeline for digital and brand-critical roles through proactive internal movements, succession plans, and close collaboration with TA for niche and leadership hiring.
Champion employee engagement through pulse surveys, skip-level connects, new-joinee assimilation, R&R programs and manager capability building, with focus on retention of key talent.
Collaborate With Finance And Business Leaders To Optimize Manpower Cost Structures While Sustaining Productivity And Service Levels Across Store And Corporate Teams.
Partner with COEs (C&B, L&D, HR Operations) to ensure consistent policy implementation, compliance, HRIS hygiene and data-driven decision- making via HR dashboards and metrics.

Rolled out large-scale change management initiatives by guiding leaders and employees through organization transformation programs, streamlining transitions during mergers, acquisitions, and restructuring periods.

Instituted Comprehensive Workforce Analytics Frameworks That Enabled Leadership To Drive Informed Decisions On Talent Allocation, Workforce Optimization, And Future Skill Requirements Across Diverse Business Units.
Led annual headcount planning and HR budget allocation in line with business growth plans, ensuring strategic and cost-effective workforce deployment across retail and corporate divisions.
Administered the performance management cycle from KRA setting to final evaluations, driving over 90% completion and reinforcing a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Drove employee engagement through surveys, wellness initiatives and recognition events, positively impacting satisfaction scores and strengthening organizational culture.
Developed and executed employer branding initiatives using social media and campus connect programs to enhance brand visibility and attract quality talent.
Delivered Robust Employee Relations Support, Addressing Grievances And Enabling Fair, Timely Resolution To Maintain A Harmonious And Compliant Environment.
Streamlined job roles and structures through detailed task analysis, delivering a 25% reduction in manpower without impacting operational efficiency.
Enhanced overall employee productivity by 15% by aligning roles with skillsets and optimizing workflows.
Achieved 12% cost savings in manpower expenses while ensuring business continuity and service standards.
Improved team performance by instituting clear, measurable KRAs/KPIs, boosting departmental output by 20%.
Led GPTW certification efforts along with HR Head, including survey execution and documentation, strengthening employer brand positioning.

Spearheaded end-to-end talent acquisition initiatives across multiple business units by deploying targeted sourcing strategies, optimizing recruitment workflows, and leveraging data-driven insights to meet demanding headcount objectives.
Developed and implemented HR SOPs and company policies, establishing the HR function from the ground up.
Played a key role during the acquisition by Reliance Brands Ltd., leading HR data migration from HRone to SAP-RConnect to ensure accuracy and continuity.
Designed and rolled out a structured interview feedback system, improving hiring quality and consistency across functions.
Managed end-to-end recruitment, including building E-commerce and Marketplace teams aligned to expansion plans.
Led HR automation via HRone HRIS implementation, covering ATS, onboarding, attendance, payroll, appraisals and exits, significantly improving efficiency.
Conceptualized and institutionalized a KRA/KPI-based appraisal system, tightly linking individual goals with organizational strategy.
Built the entire HR function at Ritu Kumar, institutionalizing HR systems, policies and processes across the organization.
Transitioned manual payroll from Excel to an automated Megasoft system, improving accuracy and TAT.
Played a leading role in GPTW certification, driving survey management and documentation with the HR Head.

Spearheaded workforce restructuring initiatives post-acquisition, aligning organizational design and talent deployment with new business objectives while maintaining employee engagement and retention.

Directed confidential employee relations investigations and grievance redressal processes, ensuring compliance with statutory regulations and reinforcing a positive workplace culture during periods of organizational change.
Coordinated End-To-End Talent Acquisition Activities, Including Candidate Screening, Interview Scheduling, And Onboarding To Ensure A Smooth Hiring Experience.
Maintained Accurate Recruitment And Employee Records To Support Efficient And Compliant HR Operations.
Assisted HR And Business Teams In Campus Hiring Initiatives And New Joiner Integration As A Management Trainee.
Facilitated employee engagement activities and supported coordination of training sessions to strengthen workplace culture and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
